summary: Tested the additive Day One Intake feature end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite (5 tests, 100% pass) covering GET /api/intake/status, POST /api/intake/commit (empty commit, event/prep type-vocab fallback, empty-title skipping, invalid competency 'bogus' dropped while 'Leadership' kept, unknown people_updates id not counted, no _id leaks) and propagation into /api/calendar, /api/stories, /api/dream/overview, /api/people. Frontend: full Playwright pass of /intake — 12 preloaded candidates with working confirm toggles (sage #9DB0A3 on, muted #EFECE7 off), competency chips (muted #EFECE7 -> sage-tint #D4DDD7, not bright), strength note, add-new-person (13 toggles after add), alumni link target=_blank with correct ISB URL, mentor chip, event/story/prep drafts, single calm Save with prose confirmation (no emoji/exclamation), no progress bar / no step-N-of-M / no red validation, zero console errors. Verified all UI-saved data persisted in DB. Regression: More -> /intake link works, People page lists candidates + new mentor, Dream Offer shows all 14 companies. DB restored to baseline afterwards (12 unconfirmed candidates, 14 companies, 0 events/stories/prep/mentors, has_real_data=false) via /app/backend/tests/cleanup_intake_test_data.py.

minor.issue: PersonUpdate model has no prep_group/strengths/strength_note fields, so prep-circle state can only be changed through /api/intake/commit (no way to un-confirm a person from the People page).

A person created from Intake's 'Add someone new' is stored without prep_candidate/prep_group/strengths/strength_note keys (returned as null/absent), unlike the 12 preloaded candidates. Intake tolerates it, but the shape is inconsistent; consider defaulting prep_candidate=true/prep_group=false/strengths=[].

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid for competency chips is not unique — intake-person-strength-chip-{Competency} repeats for all 12 people (12 matches per competency), causing Playwright strict-mode ambiguity. Suggest intake-person-strength-chip-{personId}-{Competency}.
Unknown routes render a completely blank page (observed at /dream) — no catch-all 404/redirect. Pre-existing, not introduced by intake.

issues: Date field uses the raw browser-native datetime-local picker (mm/dd/yyyy, --:-- with the OS calendar icon), which breaks the calm editorial language used everywhere else; consider a styled/calendar primitive consistent with the Modal primitives.
api.intakeStatus exists in lib/api.js but is never used by Intake.jsx — the has_real_data signal is currently dead code on the frontend (no returning-user variant of the page).

action_items: Make competency chip data-testids unique per person (include person id).
Consider replacing the native datetime-local input on /intake with the app's calm date primitive.
Optionally use intakeStatus (or remove it) so it isn't dead code.
Optionally extend PersonUpdate with prep_group/strengths/strength_note so prep-circle state is editable outside intake.

Pre-existing stale test suites need attention (not intake-related): tests/backend_test.py, test_v4_reminders_stories.py, test_v5_match_snooze.py error with KeyError 'REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL' (they read only os.environ, not /app/frontend/.env), and 3 tests in test_v7_hardening_regression.py (seeded reminders / people with 'important') now fail because demo data was intentionally cleared.
critical_code_review_comments: intake commit is a single sequential loop of insert_one calls — fine for single-user scale, but there is no partial-failure rollback; if one insert throws, earlier ones stay committed and the client gets a 500 with no counts.
Intake.jsx keeps `saved=true` and the local drafts after a successful save; clicking Save again would re-insert the same events/stories/prep as duplicates. Consider clearing local drafts on success.
_clean_competencies correctly de-dupes and case-normalises against INTERVIEW_COMPETENCIES — verified 'bogus' dropped, 'Leadership' kept.
seed_data_creation: Temporary ZZ_TEST_ prefixed events/stories/prep/mentor/person plus one confirmed candidate (Amol). All deleted and Amol reset to prep_group=false/strengths=[]/strength_note='' — DB verified back at 12 candidates, 14 companies, has_real_data=false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Intake feature verified green (backend + frontend). Reusable suite: /app/backend/tests/test_v8_intake.py; ALWAYS run /app/backend/tests/cleanup_intake_test_data.py afterwards — it deletes ZZ_TEST_* records and resets any prep_group=true person, restoring the real DB. Note dream page route is /dream-offer (not /dream). Older suites (backend_test.py, v4, v5, parts of v7) are stale after the demo-data wipe.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. The only automation friction was the duplicated competency chip testid, worked around by scoping the locator to the first person card.
